notes: A refined Google TV-style Home: useful Quick launch and selection details, simpler navigation, complete poster artwork with separate captions, and clearer app logos. Hold OK or press MENU on an app and choose Set Quick launch. Home content settings offer Apps first or Recommendations first. Home and Back reset the app/content rows to their beginnings, and menus restore the selected control after Cancel. Selected categories now show their own app count. App tile boxes Off removes launcher-added backgrounds completely. Your header, static wallpaper, saved apps, groups, artwork and settings are retained.
